notes: Counts come from the 'Seats' summary table (rows 'Before these elections' = current, 'Not up', 'Up'): Before: D 45, I 2, R 53, other 0, total 100; Not up: D 32, I 2, R 31, other 0, total 65; Up: D 13, I 0, R 22, other 0, total 35.
The seat-map key reads 'I# Independent, caucusing with Democrats', so the 2 independents count as I_D.
Vice president: JD Vance (R), from the page: "Republican JD Vance won with 53.03% of the vote in 2022, but resigned on January 10, 2025, to become Vice President of the United States."
Majority rule from the page: "requires 51 seats or 50 seats with control of the vice presidency".
races file: 35 seats up, incumbents D 13, R 22, independent 0; no independent senator is up in 2026.
Democratic caucus (D + I_D) holds 34 seats not up and needs 17 of the 35 races for 51; Republicans hold 31 and need 19 for 50.
